name: The Ladakh Riding Chapter
description: A riding proposal for licensed, experienced riders, with full support terms agreed first.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Leh
itinerary.description: Meet your arranged transfer and settle into your stay. Keep the day flexible around arrival and rest.

itinerary.title: A second gentle day
itinerary.description: Keep a further easy day for rest and acclimatisation. Short local outings are optional and depend on individual wellbeing and professional advice.

itinerary.title: Monasteries & the Indus
itinerary.description: Consider a relaxed cultural circuit near Leh. Confirm the specific sights, opening times, and transport arrangements before departure. Riding stages replace car transfers only after the operator confirms road suitability, rider experience, and support.

itinerary.title: Across to Nubra
itinerary.description: Travel to Nubra only when wellbeing, road access, and permissions allow. The day’s stops and pace remain flexible. Riding stages replace car transfers only after the operator confirms road suitability, rider experience, and support.

itinerary.title: A village day in Nubra
itinerary.description: Explore village surroundings and discuss an optional Turtuk excursion. Confirm access requirements and the day’s driving plan. Riding stages replace car transfers only after the operator confirms road suitability, rider experience, and support.

itinerary.title: Lake horizons
itinerary.description: Continue towards Pangong on a suitable confirmed route. A high-altitude overnight is optional; an alternative stay may be necessary for your group. Riding stages replace car transfers only after the operator confirms road suitability, rider experience, and support.

itinerary.title: Return to Leh
itinerary.description: Return to Leh and keep the rest of the day free. Leave contingency time for weather and road disruptions. Riding stages replace car transfers only after the operator confirms road suitability, rider experience, and support.

itinerary.title: Until next time
itinerary.description: Check out and take the arranged transfer for your onward journey. Departure timings and road buffers will be confirmed in your proposal.
